package.name: monoscale_fast
package.description:
The estimator's two hot functions, in C++.
The geometry was never the interesting part of this stack, but it is where the time goes: of 11.2 ms a pair, the anchor alignment is 7.3 and the ground projection 2.1. That is affordable on a desktop and is not on the board this is meant to run on, whose cores are several times slower.
A separate package rather than a rewrite, and the Python keeps working without it. Both implementations have to agree to the last bit for the comparison between them to mean anything, and a fallback that is exercised is the only way to keep that true.
